note: Test keys only, made by protected40.py from fixed labels (stream(label, n): SHA-256 of the label and a 32-bit little-endian counter, concatenated). No SDK trusts them.
how: Every qle1 container is the CDN form of stream-made plaintext (see container.json's how) under hkdf.json's build key; gzip files are gzip_stored. containers_hex holds every stored file, by path, so a checker can mirror the build. refuse: set manifest[set...] = value (the signed line `line` then differs by one field) and the signature must fail.

plain_rule.rule: an encrypted build stores a file plain only for role calibration at calibration.json and role selftest under selftest/ (decoded path); every other entry is qle1

plain_content.rule: a plain file of an encrypted build: its decoded size at most 2 MiB for selftest and 1 MiB for calibration; its first min(128, size) decoded bytes read (else `head`) and not a model file's or an archive's (plain_content_problem: fixed magics and the bzip2, pickle, ONNX, safetensors and Core ML blob structures); all plain files of a build at most 4 MiB decoded together (plain_total_problem); `problem` null when it passes
